title: Well made and festive!
text: Well made and festive!. This is a great decorating package of Oktoberfest decorations. I cannot wait to put it out next month during my family Oktoberfest party planned for mid-month. Colorful and well made, this is a great value priced package. I particularly like the balloons and banners. Great way to be able to make your home festive!
